summary: Iteration 2 retest of Roomie after FK fix (household_members.user_id -> profiles.id). ALL previously-broken member-name flows now pass. Verified FK via authenticated Supabase REST (John owner / Alex member with profiles join). Backend pytest 7/7 (health, JWT 401/422 guards, Kitchen AI structure + max_spend=0). Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): login John -> no 'Unassigned' anywhere; tasks show John/Alex names + correct avatars; new-task 'Assign to' pills render task-assignee-john/task-assignee-alex and task 'TEST Water plants' was created assigned to Alex; Household screen shows PALM26 + 2 members (Alex Member 0 tasks Rs1,500 / John Owner 1 task Rs1,000); Budget Overview shows contribution rows Alex Rs1,500 and John Rs1,000; grocery purchase (Coriander Rs40) shows 'bought by John' and created expense 'Groceries - Coriander' with 'Split: Alex Rs20 . John Rs20'; expenses list shows 'Paid by John/Alex' lines and settle-up 'John owes Alex Rs195'; notification fan-out works BOTH ways (Alex got 'John assigned you...' + 'John bought Coriander'; John got 'Alex completed "TEST Water plants"'); mark-all-read works; tab sweep x4 no ErrorBoundary crash (realtime unique-channel fix in hooks.ts intact and holding); Kitchen AI quick action returned 3 meals. No red screens, no PGRST errors.
